lines.text: The leaders report that Israelites, including priests and Levites, have married daughters of the surrounding peoples, mixing the holy seed.
Ezra tears his tunic and cloak, pulls out hair, and sits in horror while those who tremble gather.
At the burnt offering, Ezra kneels, spreads his hands, and says he is ashamed to lift his face to God.
Ezra says God extended grace in the sight of the kings of Assyria, giving new life to rebuild God's house.
Ezra asks whether they will again break God's commandments and intermarry, and he calls the LORD, God of Israel, righteous.
